CustomField.description: Special Billing Instruction flag. Auto-set TRUE by F-14 when any SBI condition exists: FX billing, non-standard payment terms, split billing (Target_BAN__c set), Free Months > 0. Finance SBI approval is Step 7 of approval chain when TRUE.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked automatically when any non-standard billing condition is present: FX billing, free months, split invoicing, or non-standard payment terms. Triggers Finance SBI approval step.
CustomField.label: Special Billing Instruction
